scorecard.rationale: The injected sesame-oil rotigotine vehicle influences drug exposure in rats without a Parkinson off-time outcome. An isolated sesamol experiment and quinolinic-acid Ksheerabala experiment assessed cognition or biochemical outcomes in rats. Traditional processing evidence establishes a mixed sesame-oil formulation with milk and Bala. A 2018 case, a 2021 open-label comparison with and without levodopa, and a 2025 symposium case report use bundled interventions and other routes. These report motor or functional observations without a separately attributable sesame-oil effect or daily off-time estimate. Oral toasted sesame oil remains an open exposure and outcome question.
